newsitem.title: USA: Community Financial sees Q1 charge.
newsitem.headline: Community Financial sees Q1 charge.

text.p: Community Financial Corp said Tuesday it expects to take an estimated charge of $350,000 in the first quarter related to an early retirement program offered to 12 employees.

It said seven of the 12 qualified employees elected to participate in the program. The estimated savings of the reorganization should allow for the cost of the retirement program to be recovered in about 24 months, it said.
Separately, Community Financial said that on January 29, 1997 it received regulatory approval to repurchase about five percent of its outstanding common stock.
A spokesman said the holding company for Community Bank & Trust N.A. had 2.4 million average shares outstanding at yearend 1996.
